name: Czech spa towns, spa establishments, colonnades and historic spas (cs-lazne)
title: Czech spa towns, spa establishments, colonnades and historic spas (cs-lazne)
description: Czech spas (lázně) from cs.wikipedia Kategorie:Lázně v Česku — comprehensive union of the type axis (Kolonády, Lázeňské hotely, Lázeňské parky, Secesní lázně, Zaniklé lázně, Lázeňský pohár) and the location axis (per-kraj subcats for all 14 Czech regions), plus zaniklé per-kraj sub-subcats. Records cover historic spa towns, individual spa establishments (Císařské lázně, Alžbětiny lázně, etc.), colonnades, spa hotels, parks, and defunct/demolished historic baths. Each record carries QID, multilingual names (35 langs), descriptions (5 langs), reference-entity property groups (country, instance_of, located_in_admin, religion, owner, operator, named_after, part_of, architectural_style, material, architect, location, diocese, heritage_designation, capital_of, timezone) each with 5-lang labels + QID lists, inception/dissolution years, coordinates, image_url, and sitelinks for 35 wikipedias.

meta.title: Czech spa towns, spa establishments, colonnades and historic spas (cs-lazne) - Stáhnout zdarma
meta.description: Czech spas (lázně) from cs.wikipedia Kategorie:Lázně v Česku — comprehensive union of the type axis (Kolonády, Lázeňské hotely, Lázeňské parky, Secesní lázně, Zaniklé lázně, Lázeňský pohár) and the location axis (per-kraj subcats for all 14 Czech regions), plus zaniklé per-kraj sub-subcats. Records cover historic spa towns, individual spa establishments (Císařské lázně, Alžbětiny lázně, etc.), colonnades, spa hotels, parks, and defunct/demolished historic baths. Each record carries QID, multilingual names (35 langs), descriptions (5 langs), reference-entity property groups (country, instance_of, located_in_admin, religion, owner, operator, named_after, part_of, architectural_style, material, architect, location, diocese, heritage_designation, capital_of, timezone) each with 5-lang labels + QID lists, inception/dissolution years, coordinates, image_url, and sitelinks for 35 wikipedias. Obsahuje 204 záznamů. Stáhnout ve formátech Excel, CSV, PDF.
